verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a per-expense audit trail recording edits, approvals, and policy checks, nor any audit-grade log export. The closest items are adjacent: a marketing line about 'approvals and compliance', and a `lastUpdateDateRange` filter for catching updated transactions. Neither records who changed what or which policy checks ran. Audit trails are a fair axis for a spend-management platform, so absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit
